mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a contraction in consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when RSAFS drops > 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 0.5% month-over-month signals a strengthening supply side, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances when INDPRO rises > 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 7% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) decrease by more than 100,000 in a month, it signals significant labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances when UNRATE > 7% and PAYEMS drops > 100k.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a loosening monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS decreases.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% month-over-month and real final sales (RSAFS) are stagnant (change < 0.1%), it signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST drops > 10% MoM and RSAFS change < 0.1%
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when HOUST drops > 10% MoM and RSAFS change < 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, when GDP (GDPC1) growth slows to less than 1% quarter-over-quarter and industrial production (INDPRO) is flat (change < 0.1% MoM), it signals a potential supply-side slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 QoQ < 1% and INDPRO change < 0.1% MoM
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances when GDPC1 QoQ < 1% and INDPRO change < 0.1% MoM.
